item.title: Somerset County child porn suspect arrested; man charged with hiding him
item.description: SOMERSET, Pa. item.description: PITTSBURGH, Pa. (WTAJ) — The Pittsburgh Steelers are kicking off their NFL Draft celebration with a documentary that showcases the city's identity as a town with its roots embedded in football. item.title: Centre County joins America250PA with kickoff celebration
item.description: BELLEFONTE, Pa. (WTAJ) — Centre County launched its America250PA celebration Monday, joining a nationwide movement to commemorate the 250th anniversary of the United States. Elected officials, event organizers and community figures gathered for the kickoff event to mark the historical milestone. The kickoff represents the start of a year-long series of events within the county. [...]

item.title: Cambria County fire station receives funding for new vehicle
item.description: CAMBRIA COUNTY, Pa. (WTAJ) — Citizens Fire Company of Vintondale has just received funding for a much-needed rescue vehicle with the help of state Representative Frank Burns. A $64,399 grant will be used to purchase 2026 CanAm 6x6 ATV. The vehicle will have brush-fire fighting abilities, including a hose line and an 85-gallon water tank. [...]

item.description: CENTRE COUNTY, Pa. (WTAJ) -- The Philipsburg-Osceola School District is projecting a budget deficit of $1.19 million for the 2026-2027 school year.
